messages:
alex chen: Heads-up — v2.12.0 deploy included a small schema migration for dedicated pools. Seeing 500s for a subset of Dedicated customers in eu-west1.
priya singh: Confirmed. Errors hit during migration apply step. Affected path: write->index_create. Not all hosts hit it though (looks like 2/8 shards).
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary check failed: error-rate > 2% on route /v1/generate for release v2.12.0. Recommend auto-rollback to v2.11.5. (reason: db-migration-apply-error)
marco ruiz: Please don't let DeployBot auto-rollback yet — the migration made a partial index change. Rolling back now risks leaving the schema inconsistent across shards.
sara li: +1. If we rollback app code but keep the partial index, we'll get mismatched expectations and more 500s. We need to either complete the migration fix or coordinate a rolling backward migration that cleans indexes.
alex chen: Ops proposal: 1) Pause traffic to dedicated pool eu-west1 (route tag). 2) Run conservative fix script on the 2 affected shards. 3) If fix not applied within 20m, then manual rollback + DB undo plan. Notify customers and oncall.
priya singh: @oncall-bot please standby for potential customer-impact escalation. I'll prepare the fix and a clear rollback command list.
marco ruiz: Fix script preview:
```bash
psql -h shard-a -c "-- idempotent: create missing index if not exists\nDO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname='idx_mig_202') THEN CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_mig_202 ON events (created_at) WHERE ...; END IF; END$$;"
```
sara li: quick log snippet from shard-a:
```text
ERROR:  relation "events" already has index "idx_mig_202" at character 15
STATEMENT: CREATE INDEX idx_mig_202 ON events(created_at);
```
alex chen: Good catch — script must be idempotent and use CONCURRENTLY. Priya, can you run on shard-a then shard-c in parallel? Marco, document the exact step to pin Dedicated customers to v2.11.5 if we end up rollback.
priya singh: Running fix on shard-a now. I'll post results.
priya singh: shard-a fix: success (index created/verified). shard-c still failing with lock conflict. Trying again w/ retry logic.
marco ruiz: If shard-c can't be fixed within 20m we will: a) truncate pending migration queue b) pin traffic to v2.11.5 for dedicated customers in eu-west1 c) start rollback process (manual, with DB migration reverse steps). I'll write the short customer note.
alex chen: Customer note draft: "We observed errors for dedicated customers in eu-west1 during a schema migration. We're applying a targeted fix; if we cannot complete it safely in 20 minutes we'll revert the application to the previous version and follow up with a timeline and remediation details." Keep terse.
priya singh: shard-c fix: now success after retry and backoff. Validation: 0 errors for synthetic checks, p95 latency stable. Reopening traffic slice for dedicated pool in 5m.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary metrics restored for v2.12.0 in eu-west1. Auto-rollback cancelled by operator override.
alex chen: Decision: no rollback. Manual fix applied, traffic restored. Postmortem + release-note update assigned to @marco. Closing thread.
oncall-bot: Incident note logged: INC-2026, severity: P2, affected: Dedicated eu-west1, mitigation: manual fix applied, rollback avoided.
